title: ChatResponse
description: Result returned to the browser after processing a ChatRequest. object_position is in canonical meters and is used by both the UI and verification (see .kiro/steering/testing.md).

summary.description: Human-readable description of the work performed or the failure.

allOf.description: An error response MUST carry a structured error payload.
A success response MUST NOT carry an error payload (no stale/ambiguous success).
